en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Amro Bin Usman, from Al Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Zayd Al Shahaam,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having been asked about hunting the fish, and if he has not Named (Bismillah) over it. So heasws said: ‘There is no problem with it, if it was alive and he seizes it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Amr ibn ‘Uthman from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Zayd al-Shahham who has said the following: “Once abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked
about catching fish without a mention of the name of Allah. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful if it is alive when he catches it.’”
